limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter rollover but also made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed input on the first clock after reset release, changing the original handshake timing.
The rewrite gated `valid_b` with `valid_a`, whereas the expected fix preserves the count-only assertion when the input stalls after five accepted bits.
The test exercised reset and stalls before the sixth bit, but its checks required the rewritten handshake and valid timing instead of checking that the original behavior was preserved.
